category_title: Students who disrupt instruction to avoid difficult independent tasks
scenario_title: Transition to independent practice of new math content
minimal_context: Jay is sitting at his desk in his third-grade classroom as the teacher directs the class to begin their independent math practice worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, we've finished going over the new math concepts. It's time to begin your independent practice on the worksheet at your desks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Fails to attempt his individual seatwork and blurts out loudly) This is too hard! I'm not doing this!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jay, please focus on your own paper and try to start the first problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Bellows across the room) I said I don't know how to do it! It's impossible!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best and keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Persistently calls out and bellows, causing disruptions to the point where other students complain, while still failing to attempt the seatwork) I need help! You have to show me! I'm not doing it!

task.content: Independent practice of the new content in math class

context.environment: Third grader in a suburban school classroom with a back table
context.social_setting: Whole-class instruction transitioning to independent seatwork with other students present
context.time_context: Math class on days that new content was presented

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Ms. L. gave the direction to begin independent practice of the new content
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Persistently calling out during instruction to the point where other students were complaining about the disruptions; using outbursts, blurts, and bellows; failed to attempt his individual seatwork
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Did not understand the new material well enough to complete the work independently; felt unsure of the materials

behavior_patterns.condition: When faced with independent seatwork that was too difficult for him to complete without assistance
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Causing disruptions to avoid the independent seatwork; outbursts, blurts, and bellows
